subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Wine glass is very __fragile__; you must handle it with care.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fragile"** means something that is easily broken, damaged, or destroyed; it refers to objects or situations requiring careful handling. (नाजुक)
 
 
• **Example:** The antique vase is fragile and must be moved with caution.
 
 

 
• **"Delicate"** is a synonym for fragile, meaning something that is fine, subtle, or easily damaged. It can also refer to sensitivity or precision. (नाजुक)
 
 
• **Example:** The delicate fabric of the dress required handwashing to avoid damage.
 
 

 
• Hence, the word "fragile" in the sentence is best replaced by "delicate".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resilient** (लचीला): The ability to recover quickly from difficulties or toughness.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the setbacks, she remained resilient and continued to work hard.
 
 

 
• **Sturdy** (मजबूत): Something that is strong and solidly built.
 
 
• **Example:** The sturdy table can hold heavy weights without collapsing.
 
 

 
• **Rough** (खुरदरा): Something that is coarse, uneven, or not smooth.
 
 
• **Example:** The surface of the rock was rough to the touch.
